chain.title: A Door Beneath the Flowers
chain.desc: Make the flower-bordered water pool and toss in a diamond. Establish a safe return point before you explore the Twilight Forest.

chain.title: A Mapmaker's First Find
chain.desc: Gather a raven feather for a Magic Map Focus. Mapmaking is a useful side project; it is not a prerequisite for the Naga fight.

chain.title: Chart the Forest
chain.desc: Combine the feather with the focus ingredients shown in your recipe viewer. This focus is the component for a blank Magic Map.

chain.title: Landmarks in the Mist
chain.desc: Make and use a Magic Map to reveal nearby landmarks. Boss structures give this expedition its route; ordinary terrain maps do not replace it.

chain.title: Living Roots Underground
chain.desc: Search the underground roots for Liveroot. Set some aside for ironwood while another route takes you toward the first courtyard.

chain.title: Forge with Living Wood
chain.desc: Prepare raw ironwood using the installed recipe, then smelt it. Forge equipment to support the first courtyard and tower expeditions.

chain.title: The Courtyard Challenge
chain.desc: Find a Naga Courtyard and defeat its guardian. Collect the scales and trophy before leaving so the mod records your first progression milestone.

chain.title: Proof of the First Hunt
chain.desc: Recover the Naga's scales. They are useful equipment materials and part of the forest's own first-boss advancement.

chain.title: Armor for the Tower
chain.desc: Turn your scales into a chestplate for the next expedition. Keep the rest of your scales for the matching leggings before setting out for the Lich Tower.

chain.title: Break the Tower's Shield
chain.desc: Enter a Lich Tower after the Naga. Return the Lich's projectiles to remove its shields, then finish the later phases and recover its drops.

chain.title: Three Roads Open
chain.desc: Keep a boss trophy for a Stronghold pedestal. After the Lich, the swamp, Dark Forest and snowy routes can be pursued independently.

chain.title: Below the Swamp
chain.desc: Descend through a Labyrinth in the Twilight Swamp and defeat the Minoshroom. Search its chamber for the food needed to advance into the Fire Swamp.

chain.title: The Meal That Opens the Marsh
chain.desc: Collect and eat Meef Stroganoff from the Labyrinth. Holding the bowl completes this item task; eating it is what advances the mod's own swamp progression.

chain.title: Beyond the Burning Trees
chain.desc: Once the meal advancement is complete, enter the Fire Swamp and challenge the Hydra. Attack its vulnerable mouths during their openings.

chain.title: Work the Fiery Vials
chain.desc: Use fiery blood or fiery tears with iron according to the recipe viewer. These materials also come from the Dark Tower route, so neither route requires the other.

chain.title: The Stronghold's Guardians
chain.desc: Place a boss trophy on the existing Stronghold pedestal to open its shield. Descend into the Stronghold and clear the Knight Phantom encounter.

chain.title: Reforge the Stronghold's Shards
chain.desc: Gather armor shards in the Stronghold, assemble clusters and smelt them into knightmetal. Build the equipment you want before tackling the tower.

chain.title: Atop the Dark Tower
chain.desc: Climb the Dark Tower and use its Ghast Traps during the rooftop fight. Defeat the Ur-Ghast and collect the trophy and tears.

chain.title: The Snowy Branch
chain.desc: Locate a Yeti Lair after the Lich and defeat its Alpha Yeti. Collect the fur so the forest records the snowy progression milestone.

chain.title: Warmth for the Glacier
chain.desc: Turn the Alpha Yeti's fur into equipment for the glacier expedition. Collecting the fur advances the snowy route and prepares you for the Aurora Palace.

chain.title: The Aurora Palace
chain.desc: Climb the Aurora Palace and defeat the Snow Queen. This completes the glacier branch alongside the Hydra and Ur-Ghast routes.

chain.title: The Three Paths Rejoin
chain.desc: With the three branches complete, explore the Highlands, giant clouds and Troll Caves for the Lamp of Cinders. It clears the thorn barrier; Final Castle completion varies with mod version.

content_revision: 2026-10-07: explicit branches, operational guidance, no collection filler

coverage.scope: Portal, mapmaking, the three independent post-Lich boss routes, and their Highlands convergence.
coverage.limitations: Targets the 1.20.1 boss advancement graph. Item tasks do not detect eating or placing; descriptions explicitly explain those in-world actions. Final Castle content is not treated as a finished boss encounter.
coverage.verification_detail: Item models, entity language identifiers, dimension data, recipes and bundled guide text where present were inspected; this is data verification, not a Minecraft playthrough.

notes: Each requires list is intentional. Empty lists are independent entry routes. Links describe guided progression or demonstrated recipe/boss gates, not an assertion that every dependency is a game-enforced lock. Runtime scanning still filters unavailable items and entities.
